Class RaspberryPiService

java.lang.Object
at.qe.skeleton.services.RaspberryPiService
@Service public class RaspberryPiService extends Object
Service layer responsible for managing Raspberry Pi devices and their relationships with rooms and sensor stations.

This service enforces business rules such as:

  • Each room can have at most one Raspberry Pi
  • Sensor stations are managed and attached to Raspberry Pis
  • Device lifecycle states (ACTIVE, DECOMMISSIONED) are handled consistently

It also provides internal methods that bypass security restrictions for system-level workflows.

      @PreAuthorize("hasAuthority('SYSTEM_ADMIN')") public void delete(Long id)
      Decommissions a Raspberry Pi.

      Instead of hard deletion:

      • Removes room association
      • Marks device and sensor stations as DECOMMISSIONED

      public void addAvailableSensorStations(Long id, List<String> stationBleMacs)
